top_signals.title: Stellantis Plans Temporary Halts at Some of its Plants in France
top_signals.summary: Stellantis NV said it will temporarily suspend operations at some plants in France next month amid a shortage of long-range electric-vehicle batteries and efforts to contain dealer inventories.
